Legal RAG Bench: expert-written QA pairs with passage IDs into corpus.jsonl. Corpus included.
IFC-Bench v2: question/ground_truth/ifc_model/project/category. No explicit passage span. Source IFC models required.
Sample of EIOPA Q&A archive. Contains answer and regulation_reference/article, but no passage span or derivation. Full archive and referenced regulations needed for usable eval.

Test split has 660 instruction/output pairs. Source field gives regulation reference but no passage span. Train file has 8899 total rows, of which 5922 carry non-empty instruction questions; overlap checked against those.
test_ground_truth.json contains PMID->answer labels. ori_pqal.json contains questions and contexts. Raw PubMed abstracts required for full retrieval corpus.

Rows are query-product judgments; question counts are unique query texts. exact_queries_small test queries are a subset of Amazon ESCI test queries. Product catalogs are the raw corpus.
